Small font size

I told her not to worry, since it allowed me to get a head start on tomorrow's work,
and besides, I hadn't tried to stop her either. To which—

Indeed, it is quite unusual for a Mejiro family driver
to be taking things even more leisurely than myself.
...Was that really alright, I wonder?

.
Well then... I shall make myself at home for a little while~.

Any plans of "leaving early" were long gone.
The clock showed that it was nearly time for overtime.

Could it be that I have kept you waiting
all this time as well, Trainer~?

...
...Fufu, it somehow brings back memories~.

After walking a rather puzzled-looking Mejiro Bright back to her dorm,
I decided to call it a day.

『Therefore, we regret to inform you that
your outing from the academy will no longer be necessary, so—』

Yes. Right now, I am waiting for the car from the estate
to come vroom~ing over to pick me up for my errands, but...

...When you are by my side, Trainer...
I feel even more—

『Pardon the intrusion, Lady Bright. Regarding today's schedule,
due to various circumstances, it has been postponed.』

It was an early afternoon bathed in the dazzling early summer sun.
Just as the end-of-day chime rang, the Trainer's office door opened.

So~, would it be all right if I waited here
until it is time for my ride to arrive?

I, for one,
had so much fun getting to talk with you, though~...

Trainer.
Do you have a moment to spare right now~?

The one who walked in was my trainee, Mejiro Bright.
However, she was supposed to have business with her family today—
Ehehe, is that so~? Well then, I suppose it all worked out for the best.

Yes~. Just the other day,
Father was kind enough to send me some tickets—

...Oh my~?
My, my... It is already completely dusk, isn't it~?

Let us call and confirm............ Oh?
The screen is completely pitch-black~.

True, with no training scheduled today, I could leave earlier than usual.
Still, I can't very well just leave Mejiro Bright to fend for herself.

I suppose so~... But taking things slow is my specialty.
Shall we wait a little longer?

If that is truly all right with you, then wonderful~...
Though I do feel we might have taken things a wee bit too 'leisurely.'

Ah, but today is a day you can clock out early, isn't that right, Trainer?
Will you be heading out from this room soon~?

It has truly become summer, hasn't it~?
Our next day off will surely be a splendid day for an amusement park.

I get the feeling that I might end up becoming
even more of a slowpoke...

Sitting side by side like this, taking things so very leisurely...
We did this back in the winter too, didn't we~...

Even though the sun had completely dipped below the horizon...
there was no doubt we had spent a quiet, fulfilling time together.

...My, this message is from three whole hours ago.
Which means...

Plugging the phone into the charger, I checked it once it sputtered back to life,
finding several voicemails waiting.

For a while, we engage in idle chitchat.
The leisurely passing of time is pleasant, but—
(Ding-dong... Dang-dong...)
